title: [Safety] SMB interval is ignored when SMB is counted as meal bolus due to errors
body:
AndroidAPS: **3.0.0.2-dev-j** The pump: **Medtronic 715** The precise time the problem occurred: **2022-06-04 03:20-04:10** The problem's description: **SMB interval is ignored when SMB is counted as meal bolus due to errors.** **[AndroidAPS._2022-06-04_00-00-00_.1.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8840347/AndroidAPS._2022-06-04_00-00-00_.1.zip)** I discovered that in addition to SMBs there were SEVERAL meal boluses at night. Hence AndroidAPS ignored SMB interval and gave insulin every 2-3 minutes. But in my case I have 9 mins SMB interval! Good SMB has: ```03:26:40.193 [Thread-6297] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandSMBBolus.execute():36]: Result success: true enacted: true``` Bad SMB has: ```03:23:51.471 [Thread-6252] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandSMBBolus.execute():36]: Result success: false enacted: false``` BUT! Due to the connection problems these "bad" SMBs were marked as a "meal bolus" not as SMB. Though aaps counted the given insulin. As you can see - there are no any manual boluses at night 03:20-04:10 but the most of SMBs are counted as "meal boluses":
One possible solution (offered by lucasvr at Discord): I think this idea about max(3min, smb_interval) is great! It would be a really quick and easy fix that would work very well. Though the reason of the problem will not be resolved but the fix will add extra safety for sure. One more thought from Discord: I can confirm that there were connection problem for about 1 hour before the first SMB (you can see it in the log-file).

comments.body: Just wanted to mention that those two issues might be connected: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/830#issuecomment-1087982826
